reserveReview.rationale: Refreshed 2026-09-29 from the AFI verification network. The rwaUSDi verification dashboard and its signed reserve-breakdown feed now publish a current collateral distribution: Li Mines $600,000,000 (40%), Commodities (Gold) $450,000,000 (30%), Real Estate $375,000,000 (25%), and Cu Mines $75,000,000 (5%), totalling $1,500,000,000. The category total equals the TEE-attested and ZK-verified aggregate reserves in the same proof payload (proof 3eb0ce0917dbb230, TEE attestation timestamp 2026-09-29T14:30:46Z), which reports total liabilities of $479,782,100 matching the issuance-parameter circulation and the dashboard chainwise supply distribution across Ethereum, Base, Monad, Arbitrum One, and Pharos. The 2026-09-04 review held one unresolved basket because only aggregate totals were published; the published breakdown now resolves the category split, so the basket-needs-split disposition is replaced by four category slices. Instrument-level facts remain undisclosed: the proof pipeline commits each reserve record's custodian identifier, asset identifier, and value as private salted fields, so individual obligors, the legal form of each position, the gold holding form, seniority, maturities, and valuation marks stay unknown, and slices carry undisclosed-obligor descriptors with conservative high risk tiers. Multipli documentation frames rwaUSDi as a permissioned institutional credit layer financing mines, infrastructure, and real assets through private pools, and the January 5, 2026 Chainrisk asset-base letter independently corroborates natural-resource and real-estate originators behind the network with a combined asset base above $2.5 billion.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: AFI verification-network Collateral Distribution for rwaUSDi (Li Mines $600,000,000 / 40%, Commodities Gold $450,000,000 / 30%, Real Estate $375,000,000 / 25%, Cu Mines $75,000,000 / 5%), retrieved 2026-09-29 from the signed reserve-breakdown feed; category values sum exactly to the TEE- and ZK-verified aggregate reserves of $1,500,000,000
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Category weights are fully disclosed and sum to the verified aggregate, so no share of the composition is unknown. Instrument-level facts sit outside the disclosure: individual obligors and counterparties, the legal form of each position (credit, equity, royalty, or offtake), the gold holding form, custodian identities and shares, seniority, maturities, and valuation marks are committed as private salted fields and are not published.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The AFI data pipeline commits a custodian identifier, asset identifier, and USD value for every reserve record inside the enclave, and the dashboard describes eligible collateral held in approved custody, but no custodian name, share, jurisdiction, segregation term, or bankruptcy-remoteness arrangement is published. Multipli's issuer-custody documentation names institutional-grade counterparty standards for the rwaUSD liquid class and an insurance framework underwritten by Realm without identifying rwaUSDi-specific custodians.
